LanguageData.PhobosBayTrip_LineCalling: Waiting for a driver to take it to a dyno bay ({WORK} work).
LanguageData.PhobosBayTrip_LineDriving: On its way to a dyno bay for repair.
LanguageData.PhobosBayTrip_LineAtBay: At a dyno bay for repair.
LanguageData.PhobosBayTrip_LineCallingHome: Finished at the dyno bay: waiting for a driver to take it home ({WORK} work).
LanguageData.PhobosBayTrip_LineDrivingHome: On its way home from the dyno bay.
LanguageData.PhobosBayTrip_LineKeptOut: Not taken to a dyno bay unless you take it there.
LanguageData.PhobosBayTrip_CannotDrive: Needs a dyno bay, but cannot be driven there. {REASON}
LanguageData.PhobosBayTrip_CannotLeave: Finished at the dyno bay, but cannot be driven away. {REASON}
LanguageData.PhobosBayTrip_NoDriver: Waiting for a driver to a dyno bay: nobody doing {WORK} work has come.
LanguageData.PhobosBayTrip_WouldNotStart: Would not start for its trip to a dyno bay. It will be tried again in a day.
LanguageData.PhobosBayTrip_NoWay: Found no way to a dyno bay. It will be tried again in a day.
LanguageData.PhobosBayTrip_NoWayHome: Found no way home from the dyno bay, and stays where it stopped.
LanguageData.PhobosBayTrip_WaitsForParts: Needs a dyno bay, but waits for parts first. {WORK} needs {SUPPLIES}.
LanguageData.PhobosBayTrip_NoBay: Needs a dyno bay, and the colony has none.
LanguageData.PhobosBayTrip_BayOff: Needs a dyno bay, and none has power.
LanguageData.PhobosBayTrip_NoRoom: Needs a dyno bay, and none has room beside it that this vehicle can drive to.
LanguageData.PhobosBayTrip_KeptOutSet: {VEHICLE} will no longer be taken to a dyno bay unless you take it there.
LanguageData.PhobosBayTrip_KeptOutCleared: {VEHICLE} will be taken to a dyno bay when it needs one.
LanguageData.PhobosBayTrip_FleetSwitch: Taken to a dyno bay when it needs one
LanguageData.PhobosBayTrip_FleetSwitchTip: Ticked, a colonist drives this vehicle to a dyno bay when it has work that needs one, and home again when the work is done. Unticked, it stays where it is until you move it.
LanguageData.PhobosBayTrip_Alert: Vehicles waiting for a dyno bay
LanguageData.PhobosBayTrip_AlertIntro: These vehicles need work at a dyno bay and cannot be taken there yet:
LanguageData.PhobosBayTrip_NoTug: No vehicle with a recovery winch is free to tow it.
LanguageData.PhobosBayTrip_CannotPush: It cannot be pushed by hand as it stands.
LanguageData.PhobosBayTrip_TooHeavyToPush: It would take {COUNT} people to push it, and no more than {MOST} can get their hands on it.
LanguageData.PhobosBayTrip_NoWayToPush: Needs a dyno bay, but there is no way to push it there as it stands. It will be tried again in a day.
LanguageData.PhobosBayTrip_NotEnoughHands: Not enough people came to push it to a dyno bay. It will be tried again in a day.
LanguageData.PhobosBayTrip_TooHeavyHere: It became too heavy to push where it stands. It will be tried again in a day.
LanguageData.PhobosBayTrip_LeftShort: {TUG} could not bring it into a dyno bay's reach. It will be tried again in a day.
LanguageData.PhobosBayTrip_TugWouldNotStart: {TUG} would not start to tow it to a dyno bay. It will be tried again in a day.
LanguageData.PhobosBayTrip_NoRoomBesideWreck: {TUG} found no room beside it to couple it up. It will be tried again in a day.
LanguageData.PhobosBayTrip_NoRoomToCouple: {TUG} had no room behind it to couple it up. It will be tried again in a day.
LanguageData.PhobosBayTrip_NobodyCoupled: Nobody came to couple it to {TUG}. It will be tried again in a day.
LanguageData.PhobosBayTrip_NoRoomAtBay: {TUG} found nowhere to stop by the dyno bay with it in tow. It will be tried again in a day.
LanguageData.PhobosBayTrip_TowThreat: Its tow to a dyno bay was called off because of enemies. It will be tried again in a day.
LanguageData.PhobosBayTrip_TowTaken: {TUG} was given other orders while towing it. It will be tried again in a day.
LanguageData.PhobosBayTrip_TowCalledOff: Its tow to a dyno bay was called off. It will be tried again in a day.
LanguageData.PhobosBayTrip_LineAwaitingTow: Waiting for {TUG} to tow it to a dyno bay.
LanguageData.PhobosBayTrip_LineTowed: Being towed to a dyno bay by {TUG}.
LanguageData.PhobosBayTrip_LineShunted: Being winched into a dyno bay's reach by {TUG}.
LanguageData.PhobosBayTrip_LinePushed: Being pushed to a dyno bay by hand: {NOW} of {COUNT} people at it.
LanguageData.PhobosBayTrip_LineFetchCalling: Waiting for a driver to fetch {WRECK} ({WORK} work).
LanguageData.PhobosBayTrip_LineFetchDriving: On its way to tow {WRECK} to a dyno bay.
LanguageData.PhobosBayTrip_LineFetchCoupling: Waiting for someone to couple {WRECK} to it.
LanguageData.PhobosBayTrip_LineFetchCallingTow: Coupled to {WRECK}: waiting for a driver ({WORK} work).
LanguageData.PhobosBayTrip_LineFetchStanding: Winching {WRECK} into a dyno bay's reach.
LanguageData.PhobosVehiclePark_Desc: Mark ground where vehicles are parked. A vehicle with no depot bay of its own is driven here once its work at a dyno bay is done. Keep it one vehicle deep beside a road, so nothing is boxed in.
